column2: The ability deals one damage even if the land produces no mana when it was tapped to use a mana ability.
column3: Outdated: dated 2004-10-04, before the CR effective 2015-07-17 (Magic Origins) added 106.10a, now 106.12a: “An ability that triggers whenever a permanent “is tapped for mana” or is tapped for mana of a specified type triggers whenever such a mana ability resolves and produces mana or the specified type of mana.” (the CR effective 2015-03-27 has no such rule; archived CR texts). Overabundance's “Whenever a player taps a land for mana” doesn't trigger for a land whose mana ability produced no mana, so it deals no damage then. The engine follows the CR (tests/rulings/r_residue_misc_1_mana.rs, overabundance_doesnt_trigger_for_a_land_that_produced_no_mana); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
